pitch-black.$description: Pitch Black — Primary text, filled pill buttons, full-bleed dark section backgrounds, icon strokes, hairline borders — the structural backbone of every page

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark sections, button text on filled black buttons, search field fill

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Soft image backgrounds, secondary surface tint, subtle card/poster fill behind event artwork

concrete.$description: Concrete — Hairline dividers, muted borders, input field outlines

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary button fills, elevated dark surfaces, muted-on-dark text in nested components

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, secondary navigation labels, supporting metadata

stone.$description: Stone — Tertiary body text, disabled states, low-priority metadata

favorit.$description: All UI text — navigation, body copy, buttons, labels, card metadata. Weight 400 is the default; 700 is used for section headings like 'Trending in Barcelona'; 350 is reserved for quiet helper text. The 0.06em tracking gives every line a slightly looser, editorial feel — body copy never feels cramped. Stylistic sets ss02/ss03/ss05/ss06/ss08 are always on and define the character of the typeface.

foggy.$description: Hero display headlines only. The extreme condensed proportions, ultra-tight 0.83 line-height, and 106px size let 3–4 stacked words fill a half-screen. This is the signature element — it transforms standard product copy ('WELCOME TO THE ALTERNATIVE') into a gig poster.
